description: Answers 'what did BTC (or ETH, SOL) do?' Give a symbol (pair, e.g. BTC-USD) and optionally interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1hour or 1day, default 1day) plus start and end. Returns OHLCV bars clipped to as_of. Covers 512 crypto pairs (BTC-USD since 2013, ETH-USD since 2016, SOL-USD and more). Free keys get daily bars for the last 12 months; intraday bars and full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_crypto
title: Get crypto bars
